title: Orus
summary: Orus is named in Cory, Ancient Fragments (1876, ed. Hodges), with a reign length or synchronism. Display only.
description: Added from the Cory import. Display only. Cory gives reign lengths and synchronisms, not a BC year this record can sort on, and no tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: Calculated from printed figures. No tier 1–4 birth, no tier reign start, and no provisional year. Raleigh prints the yeere of the World 2276. Creation is 4032 BC (Kevin, 2026-10-28). BC = 4033 − AM, so AM 2276 = 1757 BC. The figure is not written into year_bc_ad. A printed year for this person would replace it.
